children: Gold.com has appointed Jill Van as its next chief financial officer, effective immediately.
Van joined the precious metals assets platform in June of last year, and brings to the role over 25 years of accounting, audit and financial leadership experience.
She spent over 20 years in public accounting, including audit partner roles at RSM US and Grant Thornton. Van also served as Interim CFO at Hardesty and was CFO at Shew Enterprises.
Van succeeds Cary Dickson, who has made the decision to retire but will serve as a consultant to the company for a year.
